# ShipKit: Full Reference

Production-ready Next.js 16 starter. Auth, payments, CMS, email, AI, analytics, database, storage are pre-wired. Configure with env vars. Don't build what's already built.

Bones is the root template and the upstream of everything. ShipKit is the everything-included build downstream of Bones; integrations are shadcn registry items you add one at a time.

Overview: https://shipkit.io/llms.txt

## Create a New App

```bash
# npm initializer (package: create-shipkit-app)
npm create shipkit-app@latest my-app

# or the GitHub template
gh repo create my-app --template shipkit-io/bones --clone --public

cd my-app && <pm> install && cp .env.example .env && <pm> run dev
```

`<pm>` is the package manager named in package.json's `packageManager` field (Bones: pnpm, ShipKit: bun).

## Required Env Vars

```
DATABASE_URL - PostgreSQL connection string
AUTH_SECRET  - Encryption key (or APP_SECRET to derive all secrets)
```

## Project Structure

ShipKit layout (Bones ships the same shape with fewer route groups: (authentication), (demo), (legal), about, api, changelog, contact, faq, features).

```
src/
├── app/
│   ├── (app)/                 # Every app route lives under this group
│   │   ├── (authentication)/  # sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, forgot/reset-password, api/auth/[...nextauth], api/better-auth/[...path]
│   │   ├── (admin)/admin/     # users, payments, waitlist, feedback, cms, github, integrations
│   │   ├── (dashboard)/       # dashboard, projects, teams, api-keys, deployments
│   │   ├── (demo)/            # example pages (upload, pricing-01, landing-01, examples)
│   │   ├── (integrations)/    # builder.io, stripe, polar, lemonsqueezy, google-docs
│   │   ├── (kit)/             # shipkit.io marketing pages (home, pricing, features, faq, bones)
│   │   ├── (legal)/           # privacy-policy, terms-of-service, eula
│   │   ├── api/               # route handlers (payments, docs, teams, projects, setup, ...)
│   │   ├── webhooks/          # stripe, polar, lemonsqueezy
│   │   └── blog/ docs/ changelog/ contact/ faq/ settings/ waitlist/ checkout/
│   └── (cms)/                 # Payload admin at /cms, REST/GraphQL at /cms-api, [...slug] page catch-all
├── components/
│   ├── ui/                    # shadcn/ui primitives
│   ├── primitives/            # base components
│   ├── blocks/                # feature blocks
│   ├── modules/               # auth, payments, blog, search, sidebar, ...
│   └── providers/             # analytics, consent, better-auth, theme, ...
├── config/                    # site-config, features-config, routes, navigation, fonts, admin-config
├── content/                   # blog, changelog, faq, features, pricing, testimonials (MDX + JSON)
├── hooks/
├── lib/                       # utilities + per-service clients (stripe.ts, polar.ts, resend.ts, open-ai.ts, payload/, posthog/, ...)
├── server/
│   ├── actions/               # Server Actions (mutations)
│   ├── services/              # business logic
│   ├── db/                    # Drizzle schema + connection
│   ├── auth.ts                # Auth.js v5 entry (exports auth, handlers, signIn, signOut)
│   ├── auth-js/               # Auth.js config + providers
│   └── better-auth/           # Better Auth config, schema, service
├── payload.config.ts          # Payload CMS config
├── env.ts                     # T3 env schema
└── migrations/                # drizzle-kit output from db:generate (generated, not committed)
docs/                          # MDX docs served at /docs
registry.json                  # shadcn registry source (ShipKit only)
```

## Features

Features auto-enable when env vars are set. Detection: src/config/features-config.ts
Fetch deep docs only for the features you need.

### Auth - https://shipkit.io/llms/auth.txt
Library: Auth.js v5 (NextAuth) runs by default. Better Auth is wired as an alternative. Clerk, Stack Auth and Supabase Auth have config in the tree.
Providers: GitHub, Google, Discord, Twitter, GitLab, Bitbucket, Vercel, Magic Link (Resend, dev only), Credentials (needs Payload), Guest (ENABLE_AUTH_GUEST=true)
Setup: AUTH_SECRET + a provider ID/SECRET pair
Built in: sessions (database or JWT), RBAC, `auth({ protect: true })` route protection, sign in/up/out/reset actions, admin roles via ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_DOMAINS

### Payments - https://shipkit.io/llms/payments.txt
Providers: Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Polar
Setup: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Built in: PaymentService, checkout URLs, webhooks at /webhooks/{provider}, subscription checks, admin page at /admin/payments

### Database - https://shipkit.io/llms/database.txt
Stack: PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM
Setup: DATABASE_URL (DB_PREFIX optional, default "db")
Built in: schema, migrations, type-safe queries, Drizzle Studio, seed script

### CMS - https://shipkit.io/llms/cms.txt
Stack: Payload CMS v3 + optional Builder.io
Setup: DATABASE_URL + PAYLOAD_SECRET (disable: DISABLE_PAYLOAD=true)
Built in: admin panel at /cms, Lexical editor, block-based pages, media library, auto-seeding

### Email - https://shipkit.io/llms/email.txt
Provider: Resend
Setup: RESEND_API_KEY
Built in: Resend client, contact form, waitlist welcome, sign-up verification, magic link (dev), Payload email adapter, audience sign-up

### AI - https://shipkit.io/llms/ai.txt
Providers: SmolLM (browser, WebGPU, zero config), OpenAI, Anthropic
Setup: OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Built in: SmolLM component, OpenAI client, AI demo components, OpenAI-backed docs search

### Analytics - https://shipkit.io/llms/analytics.txt
Providers: PostHog, Umami, DataFast, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Statsig, Vercel Analytics, c15t consent
Setup: provider key env var (see deep docs)
Built in: AnalyticsProvider wrapper, per-provider script components gated on feature flags, PostHog reverse proxy

### Storage - https://shipkit.io/llms/storage.txt
Providers: AWS S3, Vercel Blob
Setup: AWS_REGION + AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY + AWS_BUCKET_NAME, or VERCEL_BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
Built in: presigned S3 uploads, file service + actions, Payload media adapters

### Waitlist - https://shipkit.io/llms/waitlist.txt
Setup: DATABASE_URL (+ RESEND_API_KEY for emails)
Built in: signup page at /waitlist, admin page at /admin/waitlist, duplicate prevention, welcome email

### Component Registry - https://shipkit.io/llms/registry.txt
Docs: https://shipkit.io/docs/features/registry
Install: add `"@shipkit": "https://shipkit.io/r/{name}.json"` to `registries` in components.json, then `npx shadcn add @shipkit/<name>`
36 items: auth, payments, dashboard, blog, docs, admin, settings, rbac, demo, faq, pricing, legal, changelog, contact, waitlist, builder-io, cms-pages, email, feedback, analytics, ai, github-connect, vercel-connect, storage, caching, cn, routes-config, features-config, data-table, marquee, border-beam, retro-grid, shimmer-button, dock, use-copy-to-clipboard, use-mobile

## Dev Commands

`<pm>` = pnpm in Bones, bun in ShipKit.

```
<pm> run dev            - Dev server
<pm> run build          - Production build
<pm> run test           - Tests (vitest)
<pm> run lint           - Lint (Biome + ESLint + Prettier)
<pm> run lint:fix       - Auto-fix lint
<pm> run typecheck      - TypeScript check
<pm> run db:push        - Push schema to DB
<pm> run db:studio      - Drizzle Studio
<pm> run db:generate    - Generate migration from schema changes
<pm> run db:migrate     - Run migrations
<pm> run db:reset       - Drop, generate, migrate, push
<pm> run db:seed        - Seed test data
<pm> run build:registry - Build registry JSON (ShipKit only, runs `npx shadcn build`)
<pm> run analyze        - Bundle analysis (ShipKit only)
```

## Code Conventions

- Package manager from package.json's packageManager field (Bones: pnpm, ShipKit: bun)
- Server Components first, minimize 'use client'
- Server Actions for mutations (src/server/actions/)
- Services for business logic (src/server/services/)
- Actions call services; components use actions, never the DB directly
- Named exports, no default exports (Next.js pages excepted)
- kebab-case files, PascalCase components, camelCase variables
- Arrow functions for components, function keyword for utilities
- Interfaces over types, no enums (use objects/maps)
- Files under 500 lines
- nuqs for URL search params
- React Hook Form + Zod for forms
- Wrap client components in Suspense
- Database: db.transaction() for multi-step changes, timestamps over booleans (activeAt not isActive), try-catch around DB calls

## Disabling Features

Set DISABLE_{FEATURE}=true (for example DISABLE_PAYLOAD, DISABLE_STRIPE, DISABLE_POSTHOG). The NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_*_ENABLED flags are computed from the service keys at build time; do not set them by hand.
